# Ratified JaCoCo coverage-gate deviations (#180). One entry per line; blank lines and #-comments
# ignored. .github/coverage-policy.sh fails CI when a module pom carries a jacoco exclusion or a
# lowered threshold that is NOT listed here — so a new exclusion / lowered gate cannot land without
# an explicit, reviewed edit to this file (the review signal #180 requires).
#
# Formats:
#   exclude|<module-pom-path>|<exclude-pattern>
#   minimum|<module-pom-path>|<counter LINE/BRANCH>|<literal minimum>|<owner>|<expiry YYYY-MM>|<reason>
#
# Policy: an `exclude` entry must be structurally-uncoverable code (native-metadata holders, pure
# field-holder JPA entities, thin JDK-network shims exercised only by live/IT layers). A `minimum`
# entry is a TIME-BOUNDED exception: at expiry, either the gap is closed (tests added, entry removed)
# or the entry is re-ratified with a new expiry in maintainer review.

# --- structural exclusions (no executable behavior in a Surefire unit run) ---
# native-metadata holders: @RegisterForReflection target lists / private ctors only (ULTRAPLAN §6.3).
exclude|forvum-engine/pom.xml|ai/forvum/engine/persistence/CoreReflectionRegistration.class
exclude|forvum-engine/pom.xml|ai/forvum/engine/graph/GraphNativeSerializationConfig.class
# pure field-holder Panache @Entity classes: only the implicit ctor line is countable.
exclude|forvum-engine/pom.xml|ai/forvum/engine/persistence/*Entity.class
# thin JDK-network / socket shims: I/O bound to a booted server or live endpoint, exercised by the
# booted *IT / live layers (X3: measured coverage is the Surefire unit run).
exclude|forvum-tools-mcp-bridge/pom.xml|ai/forvum/tools/mcp/DefaultMcpClientFactory*.class
exclude|forvum-tools-browser/pom.xml|ai/forvum/tools/browser/CdpSession.class
exclude|forvum-tools-browser/pom.xml|ai/forvum/tools/browser/JdkCdpHttp.class
exclude|forvum-channel-slack/pom.xml|ai/forvum/channel/slack/SlackSocketEndpoint.class
exclude|forvum-channel-discord/pom.xml|ai/forvum/channel/discord/DiscordGatewayEndpoint.class
exclude|forvum-provider-copilot/pom.xml|ai/forvum/provider/copilot/JdkCopilotHttp.class
exclude|forvum-tools-web/pom.xml|ai/forvum/tools/web/JdkHttpFetcher.class
# abstract SDK adapter bodies re-measured in the provider module that jars them.
exclude|forvum-sdk/pom.xml|ai/forvum/sdk/Abstract*.class

# --- ratified threshold exceptions (time-bounded, owner + expiry) ---
minimum|forvum-app/pom.xml|BRANCH|0.70|eldermoraes|2026-12|picocli command-mode error/missing-arg branches run only under the native-profile Failsafe ITs, which X3 excludes from measured coverage
minimum|forvum-channel-discord/pom.xml|LINE|0.75|eldermoraes|2026-12|gateway lifecycle lines run only against a live Discord socket (the excluded endpoint's caller); headless Surefire cannot reach them
